messages:
Anya: FYI starting the SignalWorks POC surge validation tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final ops checklist + pricing ask. TL;DR: mixed traffic (chat ~65%, embeddings ~35%), target sustained 450 qps with a 30m soak and a few short microbursts.
Sam: got it. do we have a warm-up/priming plan and model pins?
Anya: pin to rdx/gpt-large-v1 (8-bit q). fallback: rdx/gpt-medium. cache TTL 600s. warm-up: 5m ramp to 100 qps, step to 450 over 10m.
Mike: ops recs: run on 3 dedicated workers (A100x2 equiv) with continuous batching, autoscale min=2 max=6, and burst queueing disabled for this run. expose /metrics and /trace endpoints. I'll drop a short runbook.
Eileen: security checklist: SSO + org SAML ok, KMS required (eu-west-1). They asked about FIPS and HSM latency — HSM not mandatory for POC. Need signed NDA before we share raw logs.
Anya: SignalWorks signed NDA earlier this week. Eileen, confirm KMS config and whether we should enable FIPS mode for the test.
Eileen: KMS in eu-west-1, FIPS enabled. HSM only for enterprise contract. We'll redact user-identifying fields in logs for now.
Sam: buyer asked about cost for the 30m soak — rough ballpark for quoting. Any quick math? :thinking_face: 
Anya: quick calc: 450 qps * 1800s * ~3 tokens/response ≈ 2,430,000 tokens. At blended hosted rate $0.00045/token => ~$1,094. Add ops/support + monitoring + buffer => propose $1.6k for the POC run. We'll itemize in quote.
Mike: runbook snippet (for the load engineers):
```
#!/bin/bash
# simple ramp script using rdx-bench
rdx-bench --target 450 --step 50 --ramp 00:10:00 --duration 00:30:00 \
  --concurrency 200 --model rdx/gpt-large-v1 --quant 8bit --cache-ttl 600
```
Anya: I did a 10m dry-run earlier: p50=48ms, p95=180ms, p99=420ms. Tail spikes on cold-starts and rare 2s GC pauses. Enabling prefix caching reduced p99 from ~700ms to ~420ms.
OpsBot: deployment rdx/gpt-large-v1-quant8 started by Mike at 1764220001 :rocket:
Sam: buyer also asked: what happens if dedicated pool hits capacity? fallback behavior? link to doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/fallbacks
Mike: plan is routing policy prefer=dedicated, fallback to hosted-compatible rdx/gpt-medium with circuit-breaker timeout 5s and queue rejection over 2s. We'll surface this clearly in the runbook.
Eileen: outstanding blockers: SOC report ETA 3w, HSM procurement 6-8w if they pursue. Also they requested encrypted-at-rest verification for ephemeral logs — we can provide a statement. Are we green to run tomorrow? :thumbsup:
Anya: yes, run is a go. Sam, please send the formal quote and ops contact + runbook to the SignalWorks buyer and cc me. We'll do a 15m post-run debrief and send results.
Sam: on it now. sending quote + runbook. cc'ing ops and security. tagging buyer email after this thread.
Mike: I'll be oncall for the run and will stream /metrics to the shared dashboard. Ping me if you see >5% 5xx.
Eileen: I'll watch the logs ingest and confirm KMS logs TTL.
Anya: thanks all. logging action items: Sam->quote, Mike->runbook + dashboards, Eileen->KMS confirmation. Will follow up after run. :white_check_mark:
